network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto mappa un ponte asportato sul Rio Piaro e documenta anche un ponte pedonale sul Rio degli Ondini; la corrispondenza puntuale del record deve essere risolta prima di associare idrometria.
network_status.summary_en: The report maps a washed-away bridge on Rio Piaro and also documents a footbridge on Rio degli Ondini; record identity must be resolved before hydrometry can be assigned.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
